name: High Templar Tech Limited American depositary shares each representing one Class A ordinary share
summary: Qudian Inc. functions as a technology enterprise primarily serving individual consumers across the People's Republic of China. The company's principal activities encompass the provision of micro-credit and short-term cash advances, alongside financial leasing and credit guarantee solutions. Additionally, Qudian offers technology development and support services. In a more recent diversification, the firm also supplies ready-to-cook meal kits, catering specifically to the needs of the working-class demographic. Founded in 2014, its corporate headquarters are situated in Xiamen, China.
